parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: <short pause> he that keepeth thee will not slumber. <short pause> Psalm one hundred twenty-one, verse three.

Father, You never sleep. <short pause> While I rest, You are awake and watching over me. <short pause> You will not let me stumble or fall. <short pause> I can close my eyes in peace, knowing You are keeping me through the night. <short pause> Amen.
